CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.generate_finance_insights(p_business_id uuid, p_period_start date, p_period_end date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
      BEGIN
        PERFORM private.require_action_authority(p_business_id, 'finance', NULL, 'advancedFinance');
        RETURN private.generate_finance_insights(p_business_id,p_period_start,p_period_end);
      END;
      $function$
